bus_and_regeneration.bus_caps: CBUS1-3 are three external KEMET PEH200PJ5100MB2 10,000 uF / 100 V capacitors (30,000 uF nominal only if all are installed and connected as shown). They are BOM-only/external, not fitted to the PCB in current schematic source.
bus_and_regeneration.input_fuse: F_MAIN is an external Eaton CBBF-100, 100 A / 58 V label; this is not a configured motor-current limit.
bus_and_regeneration.brake_fuse: F_BRAKE is an external Eaton CBBF-60, 60 A / 58 V label.
bus_and_regeneration.dump_network: Two external Vishay LPS0300H2R00FB 2 Ohm / 300 W resistors share DUMP_RES_UP and DUMP_SW, i.e. nominally parallel; Q7 switches DUMP_SW to GND_SYS. No system regen-energy or repeated-pulse absorption capability is qualified.
bus_and_regeneration.undervoltage_limit: No validated board-level undervoltage trip/operating boundary established by the reviewed evidence; 22.5 V is only the lower model input.
bus_and_regeneration.maximum_operating_bus_voltage: Unknown as a qualified board rating. 37.8 V is the 9S full-charge design/model input, not an experimentally established maximum. Device absolute ratings and TVS markings do not define the board's maximum operating voltage.
